_note: Cumulative DBF Instagram archive, synced from the official Instagram Graph API by scripts/sync_instagram_archive.py. Posts are keyed by immutable media id and are NEVER removed when they fall out of the API's recent window. Editor-owned fields (localVideo, relatedUrl, relatedLabel, location, region, featured, note) survive every sync — the API only owns permalink, caption, mediaType, timestamp and thumbnail.

_editorGuide.localVideo: Path to the first-party DBF clip that IS this Reel, when we shot and own it. When present the site plays our own file and offers the Reel as a secondary link, so the page does not depend on Instagram for media we own.
_editorGuide.relatedUrl: A DBF story/town/guide this post should lead into.
_editorGuide.featured: Surface this post on the homepage.
_editorGuide.published: Set false to hide a post from the site without deleting the archive record.
